articles.title: The Four Eras of Systems Science
articles.subtitle: About the scientific basis of ISRD methodology
articles.description: Systems science began when researchers noticed their frameworks couldn't explain what they were actually seeing. It has repeated that pattern four times — each time revealing a layer of reality with a precise isomorphism to human experience.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: The Tools Are the Argument
articles.subtitle: Why ISRD builds simulations — and what they are actually for
articles.description: Most practitioners working on hard problems use frameworks built for simpler ones. The ISRD simulation toolkit exists to close that gap — not as demonstration, but as intervention instrument. Every simulation on this site is a practice environment for attractor-shifting.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: Learner-First Systemic Education
articles.subtitle: A new framework for designing instruction in complex domains
articles.description: Traditional instruction fails complex domains because it delivers content without addressing the attractor maintaining the wrong mental model. Learner-First Systemic Education is a framework that treats learning design as an attractor-shifting process — using simulation, AI tutoring, and systemic analysis to produce durable transfer.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: Capability Without Stewardship
articles.subtitle: Technology keeps reorganizing civilization faster than civilization can respond
articles.description: Technology keeps reorganizing civilization faster than civilization can respond. This is not a new problem — it is a systems problem, and it finally has a science. A look at the sixty-year gap between diagnosis and tools.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: Pattern Is the Message
articles.subtitle: On systems science as meta-discipline
articles.description: Systems science is not another discipline — it is a discipline about disciplines, a meta-level inquiry into the structural properties that repeat across every field of study, from feedback loops to networks of coupled systems.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: Reader-First: Why Most Writing Begins at the Wrong End
articles.subtitle: Writer-first vs. reader-first document architecture
articles.description: Most writing advice starts from what the writer knows and works outward. Reader-first writing starts from what the reader already knows and builds toward what they need — and the difference is architectural, not stylistic.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: ISRD for Digital Creators
articles.subtitle: Applying complex systems science to the design of digital products
articles.description: Most digital products fail not because they lack effort or expertise, but because they were built without a systems view of the audience, the offer, or the path to adoption. Attractor Engineering is the corrective.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley
